title: Spanish for Spanish Speakers
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: SPANISH FOR SPANISH SPEAKERS, CERTIFICATE OF ACHIEVEMENT
outcomes: Communicate effectively in spoken and written Spanish with appropriate control of grammar, spelling, and vocabulary consistent with educated native speakers.
Read, analyze, and interpret a variety of authentic Spanish-language texts, such as essays, news articles, short stories, and poetry, demonstrating comprehension and critical thinking skills.

Identify and discuss key cultural, historical, and social elements of the Spanish-speaking world, including the U.S. Latino experience and analyze their influence on identity and linguistic variation.
Reflect on the sociolinguistic dimensions of being a heritage speaker, including code-switching, language maintenance, and attitudes towards Spanish in the United States.
Apply appropriate registers of Spanish in academic, professional, and community contexts, demonstrating awareness of audience and formality.
